data.narrative: Successfully implemented all three pillars of observability in FastAPI notification service. Added structured JSON logging with UUID request_id middleware tracing, exposed Prometheus metrics GET /metrics with Counters, Histograms, and Gauges, and created comprehensive Prometheus alert definitions with severity levels and runbook links.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained multi-stage container optimization and non-root security principles while integrating observability tools.
dimension_scores.evidence: Container size <200MB with structured logging to stdout.

dimension_scores.observation: CI/CD pipeline ensures metrics and alert configurations are checked alongside application code.
dimension_scores.evidence: Validated prometheus-alerts.yml and API health checks in pipeline.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented JSON logging with request_id, Prometheus metrics counter/histogram/gauge, and rules for HighErrorRate, HighLatency, and ServiceDown.
Anticipated cardinality explosions (avoided high cardinality user/request labels) and silent failure modes (added explicit exception logging).
dimension_scores.evidence: Kept metric labels low cardinality (method, path, status) and attached stack trace to 500 error responses.

dimension_scores.observation: Designed health probes (/live and /ready) to signal status and degraded states.
dimension_scores.evidence: Readiness probe checks DB and Redis ping independently.

dimension_scores.observation: Alert definitions include detailed summary, description, and direct links to runbook documentation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added clear summary and runbook fields in prometheus-alerts.yml.

strengths: Comprehensive implementation of 3 pillars of observability: structured JSON logging, Prometheus pull metrics, and operational alert rules.
Low cardinality metric label design preventing Prometheus cardinality explosions.
data.recommendation: Proceed to Module 05 (Failure Mode Analysis) to analyze dependency failures and failure modes.

public_evidence.student_action: Implemented JSON structured logging, request ID context middleware, and Prometheus GET /metrics endpoint
public_evidence.technical_detail: Used prometheus-client Counter, Histogram, and Gauge with JSONFormatter logging
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates production observability and metric exposure capabilities

public_evidence.student_action: Defined production alerting rules for high error rates, latency spikes, and service downtime
public_evidence.technical_detail: PromQL expressions with 2m/3m evaluation windows and runbook annotation links
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves ability to write actionable production alerts with clear thresholds

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Configured JSON logging, Prometheus metrics, and alert rules.
Avoided placing request_id or user_id in metric labels.

teaching_approaches.detail: Explained monitoring (known alerts) vs observability (answering new questions via logs/metrics context)
